seoTitle: Foundit Jobs Scraper - Monster India & Gulf Jobs
seoDescription: Scrape foundit.in, founditgulf.com and seven more foundit sites: job titles, companies, years of experience, skills, pay and posting dates. No login.
defaultRunOptions$comment: Default 512 MB, measured on Apify on 2026-11-08 (build 1.0.3): the example took 5.3 s and cost $0.000806 at 512 MB, 4.6 s and $0.000916 at 1 GB, 3.0 s and $0.001000 at 2 GB (runs 5yj39mhQRS8JIPnWh, jc8gw1bqeY08XuJbD, UqmKsoJSDlEjnsYWx); every measured run peaked at 65 to 97 MB. A run waits on foundit's pace of about 2 calls a second, not on CPU: at 512 MB the daily-test input took 3.3 s, 1,000 jobs from all nine sites 13 s, 50 jobs with details 27 s and a state search of 100 jobs 5.5 s on engine v0.5.3 (87 s on v0.5.2, which opened each job for its state). Apify charges the start event once up to 1 GB, so 512 MB halves the compute of 1 GB at the same start charge. timeoutSecs 1800: every job on all nine sites (72,668) took 7 minutes and peaked at 300 MB locally; not run on Apify.

pricing.$comment: Cost plus markup (owner, 2026-11-08, BRIEF-3): FREE 150%, BRONZE 140%, SILVER 125%, GOLD 110%, PLATINUM and DIAMOND 100% over the measured Apify cost at each tier's unit prices (docs.apify.com/platform/actors/publishing/monetize/pricing-and-costs.md; PLATINUM and DIAMOND at GOLD's), rounded up to two significant figures, never under $0.00001. Measured on Apify at 512 MB on 2026-11-08 (runs 9NB6gUpnTJcT7oAfA, 61khoDxDAMgrfDhS9, wePaJk7dh7qCRfvV4, T7dTKgalnZjWLJ3y8, tjEgimt4QDQyMcxbq, nMblcX3PUPSDuDwFn, and on engine v0.5.3 the state searches 63e3lK4Nh9QVNBQCV and ELA2isDrb2kEPoH4N): a run costs $0.000369 + $0.00000528 a job + $0.00001326 more for a job with details at FREE unit prices. That includes what every priced run pays and an unpriced measuring run does not: the SDK writes its charging state to the key-value store at the start, at the end and once a minute, about $0.0001 a run. Markup after rounding: job FREE 158%, BRONZE 143%, SILVER 137%, GOLD and above 110%; job-details FREE 150%, BRONZE 142%, SILVER 128%, GOLD and above 110%. Apify stores PLATINUM and DIAMOND at GOLD's price whatever is sent, so they carry GOLD's price here. The run start, $0.0024 flat, is 150% over the fixed cost of a run per GB ($0.000738); every measured run type clears a 100% markup on every tier with it, the lowest the 1,000-job run on GOLD and above at 140%, then the empty Hinjewadi search at 193% on FREE and BRONZE. The first pricing (2026-11-08) had a $0.0063 start, raised for a state search that opened each candidate job (87 s for 100 jobs on engine v0.5.2); v0.5.3 places Indian cities by Naukri's city list, so the same search took 5.5 s and the start came down. House rule for comparison only (SEO.md 16): $0.0018 a job and $0.0019 with details, 10% and 5% under themineworks/foundit-jobs-scraper's $0.002 on BRONZE, Gentle ladder, no start fee. Written by pricing/price_ladder.py; isPublic stays false until the owner's final check.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: Lower run start and detail price: engine v0.5.3 makes a state search as cheap as a city search (measured on Apify, 2026-11-08)

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, location, years of experience, skills, pay when shown, posting date, country site, listing source and job link. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, every place with its state and country, the qualifications asked for and pay as numbers.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).
